questions.question: What is a paragraph?
questions.answer: A paragraph is a group of related sentences that develop a single main idea.

questions.question: A good paragraph should focus on one main idea.
Which sentence is usually found at the beginning of a paragraph?
Fill in the blank: The ______ sentence introduces the main idea of a paragraph.
Why are supporting sentences important in a paragraph?
questions.answer: They explain, develop, and support the main idea.

questions.question: Observe the image and write a paragraph describing it.
questions.answer: Students should describe the park scene using complete sentences.

questions.question: Which image would be suitable for writing a descriptive paragraph?
Every paragraph should have a concluding sentence.
Fill in the blank: A paragraph is made up of several ______.
Which of the following best describes a good paragraph?
options: One main idea with supporting details
questions.answer: One main idea with supporting details

questions.question: Why should a paragraph have a clear structure?
questions.answer: It helps readers understand the ideas easily.

questions.question: A paragraph can contain unrelated ideas.
Observe the image and write a paragraph about the activity shown.
questions.answer: Students should write a paragraph describing the classroom activity.

questions.question: Which image would inspire a paragraph about nature?
Explain the purpose of a concluding sentence.
questions.answer: It summarizes or reinforces the main idea of the paragraph.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Supporting ______ provide details about the topic sentence.
Good paragraphs should have correct grammar and punctuation.
Which paragraph is easier to read?
What should you do before writing a paragraph?
questions.answer: Plan the main idea and supporting points.

questions.question: Explain the characteristics of an effective paragraph.
questions.answer: An effective paragraph has a topic sentence, supporting details, logical order, and a concluding sentence.
